channel.title: Kiki Updates
channel.description: Developer ID signed and notarized updates for Kiki.

item.description:
# Kiki 0.5.9
- Rebuilds Models to match the approved Studio Hardware mockup instead of merely borrowing its colors. - Restores the compact 682-by-802 equipment-rack composition and original sidebar proportions. - Adds dedicated dial bays, divider rails, ACTIVE labeling, an analog meter, realistic fasteners, and compact dark hardware controls. - Replaces the flat selected navigation row with the bordered sage plate and chevron from the mockup. - Uses the same circular Kiki portrait and identical layout in light and dark appearances. - Adds regression checks for the Models geometry, hardware details, and every enabled control hit target.

# Kiki 0.5.8
- Adds Meeting Speaker Identity: add people, assign transcript rows, and rename a speaker everywhere before exporting. - Carries corrected speaker names into Markdown, plain-text, SRT, and WebVTT meeting exports. - Adds TXT, Markdown, RTF, and PDF export choices for audio-file transcription. - Restores Command-A and the standard Edit commands in every Kiki text field. - Removes the blue focus outline from the Voice Studio splash action. - Adds seven Listening Display positions, including each screen corner and hover-near-target placement. - Brings Models closer to the approved Studio Hardware design with dimensional brass screws and compact dark controls.

# Kiki 0.5.7
- Restores reliable mouse clicks for sidebar navigation in Settings and Personalization Studio. - Adds packaged diagnostics that verify visible controls receive clicks at their actual on-screen locations. - Replaces the Voice Studio reading passage's accidental grey background with the Studio Hardware surface in light and dark appearances. - Gives Delete Voice the same clear bordered treatment as the adjacent secondary controls.

# Kiki 0.5.6
Voice Studio now matches the Studio Hardware design in both light and dark mode:
- A full-width Kiki-with-headphones hero uses the same artwork and layout in both appearances. - Kiki’s face and studio microphone remain correctly framed at the real window size. - Quick and Full voice setup remain available with clearer private-on-this-Mac language. - Preview can be stopped, generation can be cancelled, and finished playback reliably returns to Play. - Delete Voice and Remove Voice Engine default to Cancel for safer confirmation. - Settings, Voice Studio, Meeting Mode, Personalization, History, Dictionary, and File Transcription use native AppKit click handling so buttons respond normally.
Kiki remains fully local, Developer ID signed, and notarized by Apple.

# Kiki 0.5.5
## Fixed
- Settings buttons, navigation, checkboxes, segmented controls, and pop-up menus now respond reliably to normal mouse clicks. - Settings navigation uses native AppKit mouse tracking instead of custom click handling. - The full-size Settings window no longer treats control clicks as attempts to drag the window. - A release diagnostic now blocks future builds if either unsafe interaction behavior returns.
This update is Developer ID signed, notarized by Apple, and available through Kiki’s built-in updater.
